images.caption: Lundy earthquake 3: The Lundy earthquake is thought to be associated with the Lisbon earthquake of 1755. Some present day geologists opinion discounts this as the cause of this prominent deep gash on the surface of the island. This view faces southward. Time taken not available.

images.caption: Lundy lunchtime: The island's Marisco tavern - the social centre of the island. Food and drink provided in a building with many mementoes of ships and the sea. It also houses the only coin-operated telephone and also has a small library of books. Time taken not available.
